comment: Section 5.2 helpfully anticipates AI agents invoking governed services, including via Model Context Protocol servers. It specifies no model for how an agent authenticates to a service, how its authority is scoped and delegated from an accountable human or institution, or how its actions are attributed. Section 4.3.2 requires that actions recorded in a shared record be attributed to an identifiable actor, and section 5.4.2 requires accountability to identifiable people.

public.text: Section 5.2 helpfully anticipates AI agents invoking governed services, including via Model Context Protocol servers. It specifies no model for how an agent authenticates to a service, how its authority is scoped and delegated from an accountable human or institution, or how its actions are attributed. Section 4.3.2 requires that actions recorded in a shared record be attributed to an identifiable actor, and section 5.4.2 requires accountability to identifiable people.
public.suggestedRevision: Require that agents carry verifiable, delegated identities whose authority chains to the responsible legal entity, so that cross-boundary agent actions remain attributable and revocable.
